name: Platform fees

subjectOf.text: Centralized platform fees charged to requesters for the right to submit tasks exert downward pressure on worker compensation, so the fee structure itself is what depresses pay.
subjectOf.abstract: Such centralized fees add downward pressure on the platforms' worker compensation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900
scope_conditions: centralized marketplaces such as Crowdflower and MTurk

subjectOf.text: Removing centralized fees produces a more efficient marketplace for workers, verifiers, and requesters alike by eliminating rent seeking intermediaries, leaving gas for posters as the only cost.
subjectOf.abstract: The lack of fees on the Semada platform creates a more efficient marketplace for workers, verifiers, and requesters alike through the removal of the rent seeking intermediators.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900
scope_conditions: posters pay gas on the Ethereum blockchain, viewers do not

subjectOf.text: A decentralized network of DAOs is significantly more efficient than a centralized platform because the centralized intermediary fee, twenty five percent in Uber's case, can instead be shared between the driver members and the passengers.
subjectOf.abstract: Second, the decentralized network of DAOs is significantly more efficient because the centralized fees, e.g. in Uber's case 25%, can be shared between the drivers / DAO members and the passengers.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Gopinath Sivalingam, Reputation Protocol for the Internet of Trust - Conceptual Whitepaper (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3266953

subjectOf.text: Because decentralized cryptocurrency platforms have lower cost structures, they can remove the consumer fees integral to centralized competitors, which eradicates downward pressure on platform worker compensation and creates a more efficient marketplace by removing rent seeking intermediaries.
subjectOf.abstract: Removing such centralized fees also allows for the eradication of downward pressure on the platforms' worker compensation. The lack of fees can help create a more efficient marketplace through the removal of the rent seeking intermediators.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization - A Primer on the New Economy (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3406323
scope_conditions: decentralized cryptocurrency platforms competing with centralized platforms
